hero.description: Photo of Lloyd G. Tanner Plaza featuring Fred J. Hoppe's bronze statue of "Archie" (left of center) and the main entrance to Morrill Hall (645 N. 14th Street; right of center). Both are on the University of Nebraska-Lincoln City Campus in Lincoln, Nebraska. Photo is looking south-southeast towards the north side of Morrill Hall.
